name: Pokémon Zone · Champions
notes: Champions pages and regulation change summaries; cross-check official announcements.

name: PokéBase
notes: Spreads aggregate for M-C tournaments and in-game ladder seasons. Fallback for typical spreads when the pool has fewer than 8 for a species.

name: Pikalytics
notes: COMPOSITE (Showdown ladder + curated teams). Moves/items/teammates cross-check; no spreads.

name: PokePaste
notes: Paste host. Not a destination; Frontier Brain imports team info directly from pokepast.es links.

name: Pokémon Champions
notes: The game: free on Nintendo Switch, iPhone/iPad and Android. Download links on the official site.

name: Showdown!
notes: Use Champions VGC M-C or M-C Bo3, not SV VGC or Champions singles.

name: Showdown Replays
notes: Search and watch saved Showdown battles; paste links into a team's Replays tab.

name: Limitless VGC
notes: UPSTREAM in the Frontier Brain pool: official-event Day 2 team lists and placings (no stat points).

name: Suckerpunch.gg
notes: COMPOSITE of Limitless, Victory Road, Play! and Showdown data. Cross-check only; never added to the pool.

name: Victory Road
notes: Event coverage and authored team reports; reports explain gameplans that usage percentages cannot.

name: VGCPastes
notes: UPSTREAM in the Frontier Brain pool: shared team pastes with exact spreads, merged into matching tournament teams.

name: r/VGC/
notes: Hypothesis discovery; follow primary links and never treat comments as verified mechanics.

name: VGC Guide
notes: Doubles fundamentals, positioning and team-building principles; examples may use older formats.

name: Top Cut Explorer
notes: MIRROR of RK9 official-event team lists (the same events Limitless covers). Reference only.

name: Pikalytics | Team Builder
notes: Select Champions; verify SP rather than mainline EV inputs.

name: Pikalytics | Speed Tiers
notes: Consider priority, speed control, ties and spread assumptions.

name: Pikalytics | Damage Calculator
notes: Has Champions mode; select it explicitly and reproduce both sets/field.

name: Liberty Note
notes: Japanese authored reports and ladder teams. Translate while preserving gameplan and calculation context.

name: Liquipedia
notes: Circuit/event context; prefer organizer/official result links for exact standings.

name: r/PokemonChampions
notes: Champions-specific discussion and change discovery; verify assertions.

name: Just move first!
notes: Base-Speed recognition quiz, not usage data or full doubles effective-speed calculations.

name: Smogon University
notes: Doubles/VGC analyses, forums and reports; check generation/regulation and article date.

name: Pokémon Showdown | Damage Calculator
notes: Independent calculator UI; select Champions. Local engine is pinned native Champions generation 0.

name: LabMaus
notes: COMPOSITE tournament aggregator. Cross-check only; never added to the pool.

name: VGC Champions | Damage Calculator
notes: Champions web calculator and mobile toolkit. Verify mechanics/data version before cross-checks.

name: Nimbasa City Post | Damage Calculator
notes: Explicit CHAMP mode and M-C updates; suitable independent implementation check.

name: StatCrusher
notes: MIRROR of Smogon Showdown ladder stats (same Elo/Bo3/month cuts). Reference only; not ingested to avoid double counting.

name: MunchStats
notes: In-game doubles stats captured by MunchStats (a distinct method) plus Smogon mirrors. Reference / cross-check only.

name: Official Champions Regulation M-C
notes: Authoritative duration, eligibility link, Mega restriction, items and timers. Refresh before builds.

name: Smogon original usage datasets
notes: Original published monthly ladder datasets; adapter downloads exact M-C Bo1/Bo3 files and chaos distributions.

name: Showdown Champions source
notes: Executable mod reference; installed commit pinned, changes require tests and deliberate upgrade.

name: Smogon calculator source
notes: Native Champions generation 0. Track engine version separately from source verification date.

name: PASRS reporting approach
notes: Creator's documentation; locally adapt concepts, do not copy protected spreadsheet formulas or assume v6.2 is Champions-compatible.

name: Limitless Online
notes: UPSTREAM in the Frontier Brain pool: online M-C tournaments with full team lists, placings and records (public API; events with ≥16 players, custom-rule events skipped).

name: Pikalytics tournament coverage
notes: Event-based statistics and teams; confirm stage and regulation.

name: Pikalytics top teams
notes: Team examples; verify full sets, event, result and information profile.
